description: This PHP source file defines the PackageManagerDownloader class responsible for downloading files from the package depot server, primarily using cURL within the SuiteCRM project environment. It includes licensing comments, constant definitions, and a static method to perform the download operation.

classes.name: PackageManagerDownloader
classes.description: A class providing a static method to download files from the SuiteCRM package depot server, utilizing cURL and PHP stream functions.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a file from the specified server, saving it locally to a given directory, and returns the full path of the saved file.
